content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Portland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, high school diploma, or other credentials—and verify your hours meet the standard. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your eligibility before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Portland-based trainers deliver all required contact hours synchronously, so you engage with instructors and peers in real time. Attend sessions at your own pace within our flexible schedule, and receive your official PMI attendance documentation upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once your contact hours are verified, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the exam fee to secure your testing eligibility. PMI will review and approve your application; Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through this process step by step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to build confidence before test day. Schedule your exam through PMI's authorized testing partner, then sit for the proctored assessment. Our instructors remain available for targeted question reviews and strategy coaching.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After you earn the PMP, maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses, webinars, and workshops so you can keep your skills current while protecting your investment in the credential.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

fq_items.question: Is PMP certification worth pursuing for Portland healthcare project managers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. MaineHealth, Maine Medical Center, and Martin's Point Health Care—major Portland employers—increasingly favor PMP and CAPM credentials to validate structured project oversight in clinical and operational settings. Certified candidates are viewed as more competitive for advancement into program and portfolio management roles, where salary advancement typically tracks regional New England benchmarks.

fq_items.question: Which Portland employers actively recruit PMP-certified project managers?
fq_items.answer: Healthcare systems (MaineHealth, Maine Medical Center), financial-services firms (Unum, WEX Inc., TD Bank, Northeast Bank), and technology companies in the Portland region prioritize PMP and CAPM credentials during hiring and promotion. Insurance and financial-services roles particularly reward certification with advancement opportunities and competitive compensation aligned with regional standards.

fq_items.question: Can I attend PMP training from my Portland workplace during work hours?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy's live-virtual format allows Portland professionals to join from their office, home, or any location with internet access. This flexibility is especially valuable for those at larger employers like MaineHealth or WEX Inc., where scheduling dedicated training time during the workday may be possible with manager approval.

fq_items.question: Should Portland project managers get PMP certified before or after applying for jobs?
fq_items.answer: Timing depends on your target role and employer. In Portland's competitive healthcare, insurance, and financial-services sectors, holding PMP or CAPM before applying strengthens your candidacy significantly. However, if you're already employed and your organization values the credential, pursuing it early can position you for internal promotion and raise discussions about compensation alignment with certified peers.
